notes: Because the canvas and the agents share one writer, there is one rule for everyone. Every change says which revision of the slide it started from. If you edited the slide while the agent was thinking, its change is rejected rather than silently overwriting your work; it has to read again and propose again. Every saved operation keeps its before and after, so you can open it and see exactly what the agent did, and revert it as long as nobody has edited that slide since. Finally, the Activity panel separates what a client reports, such as 'checking renders', from the receipts of what was actually saved.

designIntent.purpose: Explain the shared writer: revision checks, reviewable operations, reports separate from saves.
